name: the drone emitted an opens-as strip
every choice the roster has not lit is marked dormant
the hexagons ground is never put out
putting a view out restates the strip at once (no sweep)
every closed row is one line
no reason sentence on a closed row
opening a row stacks it out
the rows beside it stay one line
the strip offers only the lit faces
no native title on a face — it is the slow one
a face already pinned to a put-out view is still shown
and it reads as switched off, not as a choice
the message is the mark's own text
